name: Phial of Hearthlight
summary: A phial of everburning light that mends the wounds of those who gather near.
description: Said to contain a hearth fire from a house where no stranger was ever turned away. The glass is always warm.

stats.effect: The phial has 7 charges. As a Magic action, you can expend 1 or more charges to cast *Cure Wounds* from it, expending 1 charge per spell level. While you hold it, you can also cast *Light* at will. The phial regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the last charge, roll 1d20; on a 1, the phial's light goes out forever.
